editorial:
Imagine your best friend asks you for a huge favor to save her marriage, but while you are trying to help, you end up falling for her husband. That is exactly the messy situation you get into here. The movie feels like a juicy piece of gossip come to life, focusing on the guilt and tension that build up when you realize you are betraying the person you love most in the world. It is a slow-burn drama that makes you wonder if you would make the same choices if you were in those shoes.

The acting is solid and makes the romance feel real rather than forced. While the pace is a bit slow in the middle, the emotional payoff at the end makes it worth the wait. If you love stories about secret affairs and moral puzzles, you will really enjoy this. It is the perfect pick for a cozy night in with some snacks.
endingExplained: After a lot of lying and guilt, the truth finally comes out. The best friend discovers the affair, leading to a huge emotional blowup. Instead of staying together, the husband and the best friend realize their marriage was already broken. The movie ends with the husband and the best friend choosing to be together, but not without losing their friendship first. It wraps up by showing that happiness often comes with a very high price.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves dramatic stories about forbidden love and friendship.
